headline: A paper reports trace-audited human-agent teams conducting synchrotron X-ray experiments
summary: An arXiv preprint submitted on 6 November 2026 at 08:33:55 UTC describes VISION-CC, a team of specialized coding agents grounded in validated scientific tools, conducting three human-guided synchrotron small-angle X-ray scattering experiments on nanoparticle superlattices at Brookhaven’s NSLS-II 11-BM beamline. The authors report complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts and an audit pipeline for decision provenance. Their audit estimates that 61–67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while methodological/scientific contributions rose from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56–61% in later experiments. The authors describe the interaction shares as approximate and limit the study to one scientist, beamline and agent platform. The team, audit codebook, a subset of experimental frames and a sanitized ledger excerpt are available; full audit data are available by request.
